info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Human Resource Management Travel Expense By Travel Expense Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Manage Travel Expense API facilitates the updating of travel expense records within the Human Resource Management system. By targeting specific travel expenses through their unique identifiers, users can easily modify details such as amounts, categories, and statuses. This API is instrumental for finance and HR personnel who need to maintain accurate expense reports and streamline reimbursement processes. Typical consumers of this API include HR departments and finance teams handling employee travel expenditures.

patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the details of a specific travel expense entry identified by its unique ID. You can update various attributes of the travel expense to ensure that the information is current and accurate.
